run_scene_optimization: run the pulsar scene optimization example that optimizes random spheres to match a reference image
create_scenemodel: create a SceneModel nn.Module with learnable point positions, colors, and radii for pulsar rendering
build_pulsar_renderer: build a PulsarPointsRenderer with a PointsRasterizer and PerspectiveCameras for differentiable point cloud rendering
optimize_point_cloud: optimize point cloud positions, colors, and radii using SGD to minimize MSE loss against a reference image
render_pointclouds: render a Pointclouds object through the PulsarPointsRenderer with gamma, zfar, znear, and background color parameters
